notes.title: Wishlist Number Update & Animated Portraits!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8168419/7a967ea67565832c0d62e42dfda9c98f0efc6255.jpg[/img]

To all survivors out there,

Our Wishlist Event for [b]Dead Age 2[/b] shows first results! ːsteamhappyː

The animated portraits only need 1.000 more wishes and then they will be definitely implemented to the game! While there were no animated portraits in [b]Dead Age[/b], this is a completely new feature that breathes more life into the characters. Here you can see an example of the conversations in [b]Dead Age 2[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8168419/666de9bf817b132995a67a0b90b9b3946b715d72.gif[/img]

In the next few weeks we will provide you all more information about the development of [b]Dead Age 2[/b] here on Steam. Look forward to our updated and more dangerous Zombie Apocalypse!

In the meantime be sure to join the other survivors on our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/5n6sdcJ]Dead Age Discord channel[/url]!

See ya all at the zombie apocalypse! 🧟🧟‍♀️
Rayk & the Silent Dreams Team


https://store.steampowered.com/app/951430

notes.title: TRAPPED DEAD: LOCKDOWN Patch 1.1 live
notes.content:
Hi everybody! 

Thank you so much for all your feedback to our game "TRAPPED DEAD: LOCKDOWN". 
Much appreciated! We would like to officialy announce the release of the first PC, Mac and Linux patch.

Here is the list of improvements: 
- Included the Portuguese language option for subtitles as promised.
- For a better balance, each character now has a carrying limitation. An inventory limit per slot was added. Now an inventory management is required by the player.
- Increased the number of characters for the hero name.
- When you pause the game by openning menus (i.e: inventory, skills, trader, etc) the enemies won't attack.

Here is the list of bug fixes: 
- Level 10 achievement is now activating on Steam.
- We removed the "Cost" from passive Skills.
- We adjust the collider in the dock ramp in riverside area 5, to prevent the characters fall.
- We adjust the collider in the stairs of Area 9 Factory.
- We now mapped correctly the XBOX360 controller for Linux. 
- We now mapped correctly the XBOX360 controller for Mac using 'Tattie Bogle Driver'. 
- In the Skills menu, the selection frame for the defensive skills no longer disappears.

Please let us know if this patch improved your game experience.
If you find any additional problem please send us an email to support@bigmoonstudios.com. 

Have fun playing Trapped Dead: Lockdown! 

Development Team
Bigmoon Studios
